title: Full Body Warm-up
transcript:
Warm-up — four dynamic movements, about five minutes. Activation only, not static stretching. Move with control and follow the counts.

Arm circles. Stand tall, arms out to your sides. Small controlled circles forward — core gently braced, shoulders relaxed.

Here we go. Stay loose through the neck. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty <break time="3s" /> Twenty-five <break time="3s" /> Thirty <break time="3s" /> Thirty-five

Halfway — reverse direction. Same size circles, the other way.

Keep the rhythm smooth. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty <break time="3s" /> Twenty-five <break time="3s" /> Thirty <break time="3s" /> Thirty-five

Nice. Next — leg swings. Grab something stable if you need balance.

Hold a rack or wall if you want it. Swing one leg forward and back from the hip — controlled, not ballistic.

Begin. Tall posture — let the leg swing, don't throw it. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty <break time="3s" /> Twenty-five <break time="3s" /> Thirty

Switch sides — same control.

Find your balance again. Easy tempo. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty <break time="3s" /> Twenty-five <break time="3s" /> Thirty

Good. Next — bodyweight squats.

Feet about hip-width. Sit down slowly, then drive through your whole foot to stand. Smooth — no bounce at the bottom.

Begin. Chest stays proud. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty <break time="3s" /> Twenty-five <break time="3s" /> Thirty <break time="3s" /> Thirty-five <break time="3s" /> Forty <break time="3s" /> Forty-five <break time="3s" /> Fifty <break time="3s" /> Fifty-five <break time="3s" /> Sixty <break time="3s" /> Sixty-five <break time="3s" /> Seventy

Steady reps, full range. <break time="3s" />

Strong. Last one — glute bridges.

On your back, feet flat, knees bent. Drive through your heels, squeeze at the top, lower with control.

Begin. Pause one beat at the top each rep. <break time="3s" />

Five <break time="3s" /> Ten <break time="3s" /> Fifteen <break time="3s" /> Twenty <break time="3s" /> Twenty-five <break time="3s" /> Thirty <break time="3s" /> Thirty-five <break time="3s" /> Forty <break time="3s" /> Forty-five <break time="3s" /> Fifty <break time="3s" /> Fifty-five <break time="3s" /> Sixty <break time="3s" /> Sixty-five <break time="3s" /> Seventy

Squeeze hard at the top — control the way down. <break time="3s" />

Warm-up complete. You're ready for main lifts.
